verdict.rationale: Superset has its own task objects: each task runs in its own worktree and branch, tasks can be triaged in bulk, and they can be managed via the MCP server alongside launching agent sessions. A community comment also implies a paid Linear integration. However, no evidence shows a developer picking an existing issue or ticket and directly assigning it to an agent, and the integration's behavior is undocumented. missing for 10: documented issue/ticket-to-agent launch flow, first-party docs on the Linear or GitHub Issues integration and what it does, hands-on corroboration of assigning a ticket to an agent

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a coding task to an agent directly from an existing issue or ticket

citations.quote: Each task runs in its own Git worktree and branch.
Bulk task management: script the creation, triage, or cleanup of tasks across one or many projects.
launch coding-agent sessions, schedule automations, open terminals, and manage tasks on behalf of a Superset user
